content.text: Intent

A minimal idea-capture register for testing the spec workflow end to end. Any signed-in user can jot down a one-line idea with an optional note, browse the list, and edit or delete any entry. No workflow, no assignment, no approval — just capture and browse.
Scope
In:
An Idea entity: a title, an optional longer note, and a created timestamp.
The platform's standard search screen and edit form for ideas.
Out (non-goals):
No voting, comments, assignment, status lifecycle, or approval workflow.
No sharing or per-user visibility rules — every signed-in user sees all ideas.
No import/export or integration with external systems.
Scenarios
None — the bean's standard screens cover everything (create, edit, browse, delete); no multi-step journey exists to specify.
Requirements
None — every rule is carried by the bean table.
Data model
bean: Idea

cells.text: default(now); the capture timestamp — distinct from the system createdAt

content.text: No relationships. No rules beyond the table. (
createdAt
is reserved: the platform injects it as a system field on every persistable bean.)
User interface
The Idea bean's search screen and edit form — nothing custom.
Dependencies
None — a new entity, no existing entity or spec is reused.
Constraints
Considered, none apply: authorization, performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost — all below the platform's own defaults for a test spec.
Acceptance criteria
None — the platform's generated tests cover the table rules.
Migration & compatibility
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.
Artifacts
An Idea entity with its standard listing and edit form.
Derived from the Data model
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

Idea - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entry in the spec's entity_descriptors.json.
Idea - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

Idea - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec folder's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js and shipped beside the entity class.
Idea.title - validation.rule (persistence): max(200) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
Idea.capturedAt - validation.rule (persistence): default(now) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
Open Questions
None — the request is a deliberately simple test draft; every platform default was taken.
